time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t=0

camera.type: handheld/tripod pan following the boat slowly to the right
camera.per_frame_shift_file: tracks/camera.csv (background image shift vs frame 0, px; negative x = background moves left = camera pans right)
camera.zoom: none detected (left/mid/right hill regions shift equally, -31.6/-30.5/-31.6 px)
camera.rotation: negligible (left vs right hill dy differ by ~2.8 px over 1320 px, ~0.1 deg)
camera.stabilized_coords: x_stab = x_image - bg_shift_x (frame-0 background coordinates); columns *_stab in boat.csv

objects.name: boat
objects.description: dark navy/black-hulled motorboat with white gunwale stripe and white bimini top (canopy) on a 4-bar frame, 1-2 people aboard, orange object/flag at the stern transom; travels left->right along the river, parallel to the image plane, throwing a white wake/spray behind
objects.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = centre of visible box (stern..bow, canopy top..hull bottom); bow_x/bow_y = bow tip; stern_x = rear edge of orange object at transom

length_bow_to_stern_px.note: shrinks steadily ~208 -> ~190 px (about -9%) while canopy length and height stay constant: boat yawing slightly / foreshortening; no camera zoom

pixel_extents.hull_top_to_waterline_note: hull side (gunwale white stripe to waterline) at mid-length roughly y 487..521 => ~34 px; stern deck lower

objects.name: people_in_boat
objects.description: 1-2 occupants under the bimini (driver), dark, ~y 455-485; move with the boat, not tracked separately (hidden by canopy frame)

objects.name: orange_stern_object
objects.description: orange/red flag or light at the transom, ~8x12 px, centre ~y 502; used as stern marker

objects.name: wake_spray
objects.description: white water trail behind the boat along y ~505-525, extends from the stern to the left image edge; bow wave spray along the lower hull in frames 9-18 and 33-41

objects.name: river
objects.description: water surface occupying the image below y ~470 (far shore waterline at y ~470-480 at frame 0); rippled, sun glints in lower part

objects.name: far_bank_trees_and_hill
objects.description: dark tree line and green grassy hillside above y ~470, filling the top of the frame; used as background reference for camera shift

objects.name: far_shoreline
objects.description: near-horizontal line where water meets far bank, y ~ 470-480 (frame 0) across the full width

events.note: no start/stop, release, bounce or contact; boat enters/leaves nothing (fully visible all frames)
bow_y ~486-487 frames 0-8, rises to ~481.4 at frames 17-19, falls to ~488 at frames 29-32, back to ~485.5 at 41 (boat pitching on waves)
